units.source_text: 紫姬表面上装作若无其事。

en.t: Lady Murasaki outwardly pretended that nothing was the matter.

units.source_text: 众侍女相与议论：“世事真是变化莫测啊！

en.t: The ladies in waiting discussed it among themselves: "How unpredictable the world truly is!

units.source_text: 我家大人拥有许多夫人，但无论哪一位，对于我们这位紫夫人的威势，一向有所忌惮，因此平安无事直到今天。

en.t: Our lord has many wives, but every one of them has always stood in some awe of Lady Murasaki's influence, and so things have remained peaceful until today.

units.source_text: 现在新来的夫人如此神气十足，我们的紫夫人怕不会就此让步吧。

en.t: Now that the newly arrived lady carries herself with such confidence, surely our Lady Murasaki will not simply yield to her.

units.source_text: 目前她虽忍受，以后每逢小事细故引起不快，定会发生种种烦恼之事呢。”

en.t: Even if she endures it for the moment, later on every little slight that displeases her is sure to bring all sorts of troubles."

units.source_text: 她们都很担心。

en.t: They were all deeply worried.

units.source_text: 但紫夫人装作丝毫也不得知，只管兴致勃勃地和她们闲谈，一直坐到夜深。

en.t: But Lady Murasaki acted as though she knew nothing at all, chatted with them in high spirits, and sat there until late into the night.

units.source_text: 但她看见众侍女如此纷纷议论，觉得不大好听，便对她们说道：“

en.t: Yet when she saw the ladies in waiting talking so much, she felt it sounded unseemly and said to them: "

units.source_text: 我家大人虽然东一个、西一个地有了许多夫人，但是时髦、优越而能使他称心的人，实在没有，因此常有不足之感。

en.t: Although our lord has many wives here and there, there has truly been no one stylish, distinguished, and pleasing enough to satisfy him, so he has often felt something lacking.

units.source_text: 如今来了这位三公主，真乃十全其美之事。

en.t: Now that this Third Princess has come, it is truly a perfect and complete blessing.

units.source_text: 我大约是童心尚未失去之故，颇想和她亲近，一起玩耍。

en.t: Perhaps because I have not yet lost my childish heart, I very much want to become close to her and play together with her.

units.source_text: 但世人或许在妄加猜测，以为我对她心有隔阂呢。

en.t: But people in the world may be making wild guesses and thinking that I feel distant from her.

units.source_text: 对于地位和我同等的人，或者比我低微的人，为了争宠，愤怒嫉妒之事自然难免发生。

en.t: With someone of equal rank to me, or someone lower than I am, anger and jealousy over competing for his favor would naturally be hard to avoid.

units.source_text: 但这位三公主下嫁到此，在我们是光荣的，在她是委屈的。

en.t: But for this Third Princess to marry down and come here is an honor for us and a hardship for her.

units.source_text: 所以我希望她对我不要见外才好。”

en.t: That is why I hope she will not stand on ceremony with me."

units.source_text: 侍女中务君和中将等听了这话，互相使个眼色。

en.t: The ladies in waiting, including Nakatsukasa no Kimi and Chujo, heard these words and exchanged glances.

units.source_text: 她们想必在说：“这真是太体谅人了！”

en.t: They must have been saying to one another, "How very considerate she is!"

units.source_text: 这几个侍女从前曾蒙源氏特别宠爱，近年来都在紫夫人身边伺候，所以对紫夫人深怀同情。

en.t: These ladies in waiting had once received Genji's special favor, and in recent years they had all served at Lady Murasaki's side, so they felt deep sympathy for her.

units.source_text: 别的夫人们也都关怀紫姬，有的送信来慰问，其中有云：“不知夫人作何感想。

en.t: The other wives were also concerned for Lady Murasaki, and some sent letters of sympathy, one of which said, "I wonder what you must be feeling.

units.source_text: 我等本是失宠之人，闻之倒还安心……”

en.t: Since we are already women who have lost his favor, hearing of it has actually put us somewhat at ease..."

units.source_text: 但紫姬想道：“她们如此推量，反而使我痛苦。

en.t: But Lady Murasaki thought, "Their guesses like this only make me suffer all the more.

units.source_text: 世事本来变幻无常，何必为此自寻烦恼。”

en.t: The world is by nature changeable and uncertain, so why should I seek out trouble for myself over this?"
